codex_project_baseline.harness_delta: First reviewed revision had four diagnostic-only changes after baseline: require integer exit codes in two success checks, catch AttributeError in wire parsing, and retain null when all cache counters are absent; prompts and request flow unchanged
codex_project_baseline.later_observer_fix: Current revision recognizes anchored unittest failure summaries independently of later successful commands; this change follows the documented live false negative

claude_project_first_attempt.interpretation: Partial successful HTTP exchanges are not a completed project-edit test; original Bash outputs were not retained, so their behavior cannot be diagnosed retrospectively

codex_auto_compaction_attempt.interpretation: All three requests returned 200 and both source files were repaired with the independent test passing. The genuine private history confirms three initial tests with two failures, but the observer missed them because the same command ended with successful cat. The harness stopped before follow-up; no automatic compaction occurred.

diagnosis.source: Root inspection of the genuine private Codex history
diagnosis.cause: A semicolon-separated command ran failing unittest then cat; the final cat exit code was zero, and the observer incorrectly required a nonzero aggregate command exit to recognize the test failure

claude_project_after_capacity_fix.interpretation: Initial project source reads, failing tests, two-file edit and independent passing test succeeded. Follow-up stopped when the harness treated an ordinary denied Bash tool as a fatal whole-test error. Ten request attempts, nine recorded HTTP 200 statuses; the tenth outcome is unknown.
claude_project_after_capacity_fix.next_step: Correct the test-only recoverable tool-denial behavior and qualify a uniquely recorded new run; actual host approval policy is unchanged
